up: Retrieve the compound ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), preferred name (pref_name), exact activity details (standard_type, standard_value, standard_units), and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4725213. Join activities with assays on assay_id and filter assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4725213'. Filter activities for exact activity values where standard_relation = '=' and standard_value IS NOT NULL. Join activities with molecule_dictionary and compound_structures on molregno. Return all matching rows without limits.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, a.standard_type, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4725213' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
